framework.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
framework.description: The ten most critical risks for applications built on large language models and AI agents.

threats.title: Prompt Injection
threats.description: Manipulating the model via crafted input to ignore its original instructions, directly or indirectly via untrusted content it reads.
threats.attack_vector: Direct jailbreak in a chat prompt, or instructions hidden in a document/webpage/code comment the model summarizes.
threats.attack_surface: Chat input, RAG documents, code comments, web pages

threats.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
threats.description: The model leaks confidential data in its responses, from unfiltered inputs, training-data memorization, or missing RBAC.
threats.attack_vector: Extraction prompting to recover PII, secrets, or memorized training data.

threats.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
threats.description: Building on compromised external components: infected model downloads, malicious packages, compromised data vendors.
threats.attack_vector: Downloading a backdoored model from a public hub; pickle-based model files executing code on load.
threats.attack_surface: Model registries, package managers, data vendors

threats.title: Data and Model Poisoning
threats.description: Deliberately injecting flawed, biased, or malicious data into training data or a RAG knowledge base.
threats.attack_vector: Seeding a knowledge base with a hidden trigger phrase that bypasses checks.
threats.attack_surface: Training pipelines, RAG ingestion, fine-tuning datasets

threats.title: Improper Output Handling
threats.description: Blindly trusting and forwarding LLM-generated output for execution or rendering.
threats.attack_vector: Model coaxed into emitting a payload that becomes XSS, SQL injection, or RCE downstream.
threats.attack_surface: Generated code execution, HTML rendering of model output

threats.title: Excessive Agency
threats.description: An agentic system given more permission or ability to act than it needs.
threats.attack_vector: Agent with full DB write access or unattended destructive tool calls.

threats.title: System Prompt Leakage
threats.description: Extracting a model's hidden system instructions, which often contain business logic or embedded secrets.
threats.attack_vector: Prompting the model to repeat or summarize its own instructions.

threats.title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
threats.description: RAG/vector-database-specific flaws: cross-tenant leakage, embedding poisoning, vector-inversion.
threats.attack_vector: Querying a shared vector store to reconstruct another tenant's confidential text.

threats.title: Misinformation
threats.description: Models hallucinate fluently and convincingly; blind trust in output leads to real-world mistakes.
threats.attack_vector: Confidently wrong output accepted without verification in a legal, financial, or medical context.

threats.title: Unbounded Consumption
threats.description: Denial-of-service against the model itself via maximal context/token generation, or cost exhaustion.
threats.attack_vector: Repetitive huge prompts causing KV-cache exhaustion or a "denial of wallet" billing attack.
